items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, he told me about it. Yeah, he, he, Dave Bailey, last I saw him, he was doing janitorial work in Sierra Mill Hospital.

ctx.x: Yeah. I don't know if you know about it. I guess you know about that. But he died up in Bowley. Yeah. Oh yeah. You know Dave Bailey?
Dave Bailey, yeah, he's a drummer.
